scope: Pure scoped child-call helper and injected observation sequence against accepted TF1 r2. No TF2 or host integration.
behavior: Binds one scope to the exact active parent ticket. Captured child caps and remaining required envelope cannot extend the parent deadline.

Serial queue, optional health and final identity reads retain actual outcomes, preserve the first fatal and suppress suffix callbacks after failure. Pending native Promises reach actual settlement; revocation does not claim cancellation.
Returns detached observation facts only. No READY, GO, provenance or performed determination follows.

R2 rejects custom prototypes before asynchronous return can assimilate an inherited thenable. Inert ordinary or null-prototype raw records are permitted; the fact schema separately requires ordinary records.

revisionHistory.finding: Custom-prototype inherited thenables could be assimilated after the child post-check. R2 rejects them; restoring the flaw fails the independent control. Original evidence is preserved.

limitations: Trusted unmodified built-in prototypes, inert data and ordinary native Promises are required. This is not an arbitrary Proxy, accessor or Promise-subclass sandbox.
No actual PostgreSQL, HTTP, native capture, transport, process clock-domain mapping or nonsettling-operation containment was tested.
Observed timestamps and process fields are facts, not validated freshness or identity.
No TF2 integration, production wiring, approved limits, host action, readiness acceptance or PM-1 rescore.
